cards.quote: The Red Sea did not part for people who only posted about leaving.
cards.attribution: Faith in Motion, Chapter 1. Herman Davis. faithinmotionbook.com/app

cards.quote: If every detail is settled before you move, you don’t need faith. You need a calculator.
cards.attribution: Faith in Motion, Chapter 1. Herman Davis. faithinmotionbook.com/app

cards.quote: Often courage is the fruit of obedience, not the entrance fee.
cards.attribution: Faith in Motion, Chapter 4. Herman Davis. faithinmotionbook.com/app

cards.quote: You can do good works nobody will ever post. Heaven is not an algorithm.
cards.attribution: Faith in Motion, Chapter 2. Herman Davis. faithinmotionbook.com/app

cards.quote: Abram went with incomplete information. Many of us stall with infinite information.
cards.attribution: Faith in Motion, Chapter 1. Herman Davis. faithinmotionbook.com/app

cards.quote: Holy waiting keeps the heart soft and the hands ready. False waiting keeps the heart safe and the hands empty.
cards.attribution: Faith in Motion, Chapter 1. Herman Davis. faithinmotionbook.com/app

cards.quote: You can fill a calendar and empty a calling at the same time.
cards.attribution: Faith in Motion, Chapter 3. Herman Davis. faithinmotionbook.com/app

cards.quote: Stop praying for a warehouse while a lunch sits in your bag unused.
cards.attribution: Faith in Motion, Chapter 4. Herman Davis. faithinmotionbook.com/app

cards.quote: What I thought was me not being ready was often God preparing me.
cards.attribution: Faith in Motion, Chapter 5. Herman Davis. faithinmotionbook.com/app

cards.quote: Fear may keep trying on faith’s clothes. Do not let it keep the outfit.
cards.attribution: Faith in Motion, Chapter 8. Herman Davis. faithinmotionbook.com/app

cards.quote: Trust is often the decision you make while your stomach is still tight.
cards.attribution: Faith in Motion, Chapter 8. Herman Davis. faithinmotionbook.com/app

cards.quote: Biblical faith is not a spiritual parking brake.
cards.attribution: Faith in Motion, Chapter 1. Herman Davis. faithinmotionbook.com/app

cards.quote: The dream was never the destination; today’s obedience is.
cards.attribution: Faith in Motion, Conclusion. Herman Davis. faithinmotionbook.com/app

cards.quote: Certainty is not the currency of faith. Trust is.
cards.attribution: Faith in Motion, Chapter 5. Herman Davis. faithinmotionbook.com/app

cards.quote: Then “waiting” is not patience. It is delay with a halo.
cards.attribution: Faith in Motion, Chapter 8. Herman Davis. faithinmotionbook.com/app

cards.quote: Your increase starts with your assignment, not their highlight reel.
cards.attribution: Faith in Motion, Chapter 3. Herman Davis. faithinmotionbook.com/app

cards.quote: I had believed I needed everything in place before I could begin. What I actually needed was the first step.
cards.attribution: Faith in Motion, Chapter 8. Herman Davis. faithinmotionbook.com/app

cards.quote: Wisdom is not unbelief. It is faith with its sleeves rolled up.
cards.attribution: Faith in Motion, Chapter 7. Herman Davis. faithinmotionbook.com/app

cards.quote: Grace does not cancel purpose. Grace launches it.
cards.attribution: Faith in Motion, Introduction. Herman Davis. faithinmotionbook.com/app

cards.quote: God is not waiting for you to become impressive. He is often waiting for you to become obedient with what is already in your hand.
cards.attribution: Faith in Motion, Chapter 4. Herman Davis. faithinmotionbook.com/app

cards.quote: Grace is not a parking space. Grace is a doorway into a new life.
cards.attribution: Faith in Motion, Chapter 2. Herman Davis. faithinmotionbook.com/app

cards.quote: Weakness is not the opposite of the Spirit’s work. Self-sufficiency is.
cards.attribution: Faith in Motion, Chapter 6. Herman Davis. faithinmotionbook.com/app

cards.quote: Fog may stay for a season. Do not let it become your theology.
cards.attribution: Faith in Motion, Chapter 9. Herman Davis. faithinmotionbook.com/app

cards.quote: Small offered is different from small buried.
cards.attribution: Faith in Motion, Chapter 10. Herman Davis. faithinmotionbook.com/app

cards.quote: The Spirit is not a vending machine. He is Lord.
cards.attribution: Faith in Motion, Chapter 6. Herman Davis. faithinmotionbook.com/app
